print(f"Delta P: {delta_P}")

mid_P = (P1 + P2) / 2

print(f"Midpoint Q: {mid_Q}")
print(f"Midpoint P: {mid_P}")

# Arc elasticity
percent_change_Q = delta_Q / mid_Q
percent_change_P = delta_P / mid_P

print(f"Percent change Q: {percent_change_Q}")
print(f"Percent change P: {percent_change_P}")

arc_elasticity = percent_change_Q / percent_change_P
print(f"\nArc Elasticity: {arc_elasticity}")

# Rounded to 3 decimal places
print(f"Arc Elasticity (3 decimal places): {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")
EOF
